confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied context only; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer and restaurant anchors are more reliable than July accommodation rates, which vary with season and events. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the beer anchor using typical local price relationships, because direct local knowledge of them is weak. The FX observation comes from RBA exchange-rate excerpts returned by search for 14 October 2026; the page itself was not separately opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single exact comparable used. Benchmarked to Polish regional price levels and comparable Central European tourist cities such as Wroclaw, Gdansk and Budapest, with Old Town and Kazimierz venues treated as the upper end of ordinary pricing.
